единицы.утверждение_en: Gemini 2.5 Flash Image (aka nano-banana) is introduced as Google’s state-of-the-art image generation and editing model.
единицы.цитата:
Today, we’re excited to introduce
Gemini 2.5 Flash Image
(aka nano-banana), our state-of-the-art image generation and editing model.

единицы.утверждение_en: The model lets you blend multiple images into a single image, maintain character consistency for rich storytelling, make targeted transformations using natural language, and use Gemini's world knowledge to generate and edit images.
единицы.цитата: This update enables you to blend multiple images into a single image, maintain character consistency for rich storytelling, make targeted transformations using natural language, and use Gemini's world knowledge to generate and edit images.
единицы.заметка: Четыре ключевые возможности, раскрытые ниже отдельными разделами.

единицы.утверждение_en: Native image generation first launched in Gemini 2.0 Flash, which users valued for low latency, cost-effectiveness and ease of use, but they asked for higher-quality images and more powerful creative control.
единицы.цитата: When we first launched native image generation in Gemini 2.0 Flash earlier this year, you told us you loved its low latency, cost-effectiveness, and ease of use. But you also gave us feedback that you needed higher-quality images and more powerful creative control.
единицы.заметка: Мотивация 2.5 Flash Image — качество и контроль поверх 2.0 Flash.

единицы.утверждение_en: Gemini 2.5 Flash Image is available via the Gemini API and Google AI Studio for developers and Vertex AI for enterprise.
единицы.цитата:
This model is available right now via the
Gemini API
and
Google AI Studio
for developers and
Vertex AI

единицы.утверждение_en: Gemini 2.5 Flash Image is priced at $30.00 per 1 million output tokens, with each image being 1290 output tokens ($0.039 per image); all other input and output modalities follow Gemini 2.5 Flash pricing.
единицы.цитата: Gemini 2.5 Flash Image is priced at $30.00 per 1 million output tokens with each image being 1290 output tokens ($0.039 per image). All other modalities on input and output follow Gemini 2.5 Flash

единицы.утверждение_en: Maintaining the appearance of a character or object across multiple prompts and edits is a fundamental challenge; the model can now place the same character into different environments, showcase a single product from multiple angles in new settings, or generate consistent brand assets while preserving the subject.
единицы.цитата: A fundamental challenge in image generation is maintaining the appearance of a character or object across multiple prompts and edits. You can now place the same character into different environments, showcase a single product from multiple angles in new settings, or generate consistent brand assets, all while preserving the subject.

единицы.утверждение_en: The model is excellent at adhering to visual templates: developers generate real estate listing cards, uniform employee badges, or dynamic product mockups for an entire catalog from a single design template.
единицы.цитата: Beyond character consistency, the model is also excellent at adhering to visual templates. We have already seen developers explore areas like real estate listing cards, uniform employee badges, or dynamic product mockups for an entire catalog—all from a single design template.
единицы.заметка: Один шаблон дизайна → серия единообразных карточек.

единицы.утверждение_en: Gemini 2.5 Flash Image enables targeted transformation and precise local edits with natural language — e.g. blur the background, remove a stain in a t-shirt, remove an entire person from a photo, alter a subject's pose, or add color to a black and white photo — with a simple prompt.
единицы.цитата: Gemini 2.5 Flash Image enables targeted transformation and precise local edits with natural language. For example, the model can blur the background of an image, remove a stain in a t-shirt, remove an entire person from a photo, alter a subject's pose, add color to a black and white photo, or whatever else you can conjure up with a simple prompt.
единицы.заметка: Список типовых локальных правок одной фразой.

единицы.утверждение_en: Historically, image generation models excelled at aesthetic images but lacked a deep, semantic understanding of the real world; Gemini 2.5 Flash Image benefits from Gemini’s world knowledge, which unlocks new use cases.
единицы.цитата: Historically, image generation models have excelled at aesthetic images, but lacked a deep, semantic understanding of the real world. With Gemini 2.5 Flash Image, the model benefits from Gemini’s world knowledge, which unlocks new use cases.

единицы.утверждение_en: A template app turns a simple canvas into an interactive education tutor, showing the model's ability to read and understand hand-drawn diagrams, help with real-world questions, and follow complex editing instructions in a single step.
единицы.цитата: that turns a simple canvas into an interactive education tutor. It showcases the model's ability to read and understand hand-drawn diagrams, help with real world questions, and follow complex editing instructions in a single step.
единицы.заметка: 'follow complex editing instructions in a single step' — сложная правка одним промптом.

единицы.утверждение_en: Gemini 2.5 Flash Image can understand and merge multiple input images: put an object into a scene, restyle a room with a color scheme or texture, and fuse images with a single prompt.
единицы.цитата: Gemini 2.5 Flash Image can understand and merge multiple input images. You can put an object into a scene, restyle a room with a color scheme or texture, and fuse images with a single prompt.
единицы.заметка: Демо: перетаскивание товаров в новую сцену → фотореалистичное слияние (строки 74-76).

единицы.утверждение_en: At launch, the model was in preview via the Gemini API and Google AI Studio and was to become stable in the coming weeks.
единицы.цитата:
to start building with Gemini 2.5 Flash Image. The model is in preview today via the
Gemini API
and
Google AI Studio
but will be stable in the coming weeks.

единицы.утверждение_en: Gemini 2.5 Flash Image is also offered through OpenRouter.ai (the first image-generating model among its 480+ live models) and fal.ai.
единицы.цитата:
OpenRouter.ai
has partnered with us to help bring Gemini 2.5 Flash Image to their 3M+ developers everywhere, today. This is the first model on OpenRouter – of the 480+ live today –that can generate images.
We're also excited to partner with
fal.ai
, a leading developer platform for generative media, to make Gemini 2.5 Flash Image available to the broader developer community.

единицы.утверждение_en: All images created or edited with Gemini 2.5 Flash Image include an invisible SynthID digital watermark so they can be identified as AI-generated or edited.
единицы.цитата:
All images created or edited with Gemini 2.5 Flash Image will include an invisible
SynthID digital watermark
, so they can be identified as AI-generated or edited.

единицы.утверждение_en: Code example prompt used together with an input image: "Create a picture of my cat eating a nano-banana in a fancy restaurant under the gemini constellation".
единицы.цитата: Create a picture of my cat eating a nano-banana in a fancy restaurant under the gemini constellation
единицы.заметка: Структура: 'Create a picture of' + субъект с входного фото, названный притяжательно ('my cat') + действие ('eating a nano-banana') + место ('in a fancy restaurant') + атмосферная деталь ('under the gemini constellation'). Внешность кота не описывается — берётся из прикреплённого изображения. Цитата есть и в txt, и в <pre>.

единицы.утверждение_en: API usage: call client.models.generate_content with model "gemini-2.5-flash-image-preview" and contents=[prompt, image]; iterate over response.candidates[0].content.parts, printing text parts and decoding inline_data parts as images.
единицы.заметка: Ответ может содержать и текстовые, и картиночные части (if part.text / elif part.inline_data). Конфигурации (формат, модальности) в примере нет.

единицы.утверждение_en: Google is actively working to improve long-form text rendering, even more reliable character consistency, and factual representation such as fine details in images.
единицы.цитата: We are actively working to improve long-form text rendering, even more reliable character consistency, and factual representation like fine details in images.
единицы.заметка: Известные слабые места модели на момент запуска: длинный текст, стабильность персонажа, мелкие фактические детали.

длинная_дистанция.утверждение_en: For reference-based generation, the code passes the text prompt and the input image together in one contents list (prompt first, then image), and the prompt names the subject of the attached image only by a possessive reference ("my cat"), leaving its appearance to the image.
длинная_дистанция.заметка: Порядок частей — как в примере; страница не утверждает, что порядок обязателен.

длинная_дистанция.утверждение_en: Because every output image is billed as a fixed 1290 output tokens, the per-image price ($0.039) does not depend on the prompt; any text the model returns alongside the image is billed separately under Gemini 2.5 Flash pricing.

противоречия_внутри: Консистентность персонажа подаётся как ключевое достижение (E-141-2, E-141-6), и в том же посте — как область, требующая доработки ('even more reliable character consistency', E-141-17): не противоречие, а оговорка об ограниченной надёжности.
не_сказано: Нет управления форматом/разрешением и лимита числа входных картинок.
Нет советов по составлению промптов, кроме примера в коде.
Стабильный id модели не назван — только preview-id в коде.
Не упомянуты видимый водяной знак и thinking.
Не сказано, как добиться стабильного текста при известной слабости long-form text rendering.
сомнения: Цена и статус preview — на дату публикации (26.08.2025); могли измениться.
Промпт из build mode ('Build me an image editing app...') не выделен в единицу — это промпт для генерации кода, а не картинки.
